description: Sentiment-scored news (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/news/{ticker}, e.g. https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/news/AAPL — 0.001 credits per call ($0.005 when paid per call over x402); works with no credentials up to 25 call(s)/day per address) Missing data? Call `request_data`.

ticker.description: The real ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL; share classes as BRK.B or BRK-B. Substitute it into the path (/fundamentals/AAPL), never the literal {ticker}.

name: news
title: Sentiment-scored news
